CUT: 27:12-27:17 'oh s**t', 28:01 'Uranus' wordplay (the cut skips 27:51-28:06), the browser window with chat names (h5 30:46-30:56, between F and G), 'anjeng virus' at ~30:57-31:05 (G ends 31:04.8 before the voice; check by ear), 33:50-34:25 Lucia in a bra top, the ride-share app screens (36:36-38:00), the body on the ground at 39:50, 41:45.7 'anjir', the in-game subtitles 'The hell..?' (25:49-25:52, outside the cuts) and 'Where am I'. In-game subtitles sit below source y846 and are cropped away by the face layout. No guns, gore, drugs in these frames. Main 42.65 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
